item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Frida Sundemo - For you, love (Japanese CD), 2013
item.description:
Hi guys:

It's been years now, that I haven't been able to get hold of a lossless version of this entire album, seems like this album was not distributed digitally (or perhaps it has but haven't been able to locate an online store that carries it).

Any kind soul from Japan that has this physical CD that would be the most generous human to rip it in lossless form (flac/alac/ape/wav) and make it available to download?

Hopefully this time I'll be lucky.

As always, forever grateful.
